coverLetter:
Maya Linden
Portland, OR, USA
maya.linden@example.com
+1 555 0142

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Datadog

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your Campaign Operations team has to keep a global email program accurate and well coordinated while the APJ Marketing team keeps growing. I've worked on the small-scale version of that problem. At Harbor Street Pet Supply I wrote and scheduled one newsletter a week and grew the list from 640 to 1,150 subscribers by adding a sign-up QR code at the till.

As a Marketing Intern there, and earlier as Social Media Lead for the Westbrook Film Society, I learned to juggle several projects at once and to check every link and caption before it went out. I've used Mailchimp for email, Google Analytics (basic) and Instagram Insights for reporting, and Excel for tracking results. I haven't worked in Marketo yet, but I'm keen to learn marketing automation and reporting tools, and my Google Analytics for Beginners and HubSpot Content Marketing courses (both 2024) show I pick up new platforms quickly. My B.A. in Communications gave me the written and verbal communication skills to work with Demand Generation, Field Marketing and Partner Marketing teams.

I'd welcome the chance to talk about how I can support your campaign execution in the hybrid Singapore office. I'm available to start a conversation at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Maya Linden
